research.name: Golazo
research.note: Terminal football tracker with a block-digit scoreboard and a two-sided, minute-by-minute event timeline for each match.

effects: large red block-digit scoreline rendered above the match details
two-sided event timeline with home events left and away events right of a central minute column
World Cup knockout bracket drawn with box characters and flag emoji
possession and shots shown as inline gradient bars
